description: Income tax on a CHF 100,000 gross salary in every Swiss commune (federal + cantonal + communal, no church tax, no wealth), from the official ESTV/FTA tax calculator, for two households: single (35) and married couple with two children (one earner). Give a commune (name or BFS number) for its tax and rank of all communes, a canton for its lowest and highest communes, or nothing for the national lowest/highest. household: single or family.
name: tax_by_commune
